lead.event: Merdeka Gold Resources reports a nine-month net loss as Pani mine production ramps up
lead.headline: EMAS reports Rp339.6 billion nine-month loss as Pani mine production ramps up
lead.blurb: Merdeka Gold recorded a US$19 million loss attributable to owners for the first nine months of 2026, despite gross profit of US$33.3 million, operating profit of US$18 million and EBITDA of US$42.7 million. It cited timing differences between production and sales recognition, plus tax expenses. Gold output rose 69% quarter on quarter to 26,331 ounces in Q3, and the annualized run rate reached about 147,000 ounces in early October. Q4 sales are projected to more than double from Q3’s 8,680 ounces.
